metadata.title: Stocks open mostly higher, but tech is a bit of a drag - MarketWatch

content.text:
26 min ago
Stocks open mostly higher, but tech is a bit of a drag
Stocks opened mostly higher, but only slightly, as investors seemed happy to sit on their hands until Fed Chair Kevin Warsh speaks at the Jackson Hole economic summit this morning.
In a bit of a reversal of Thursday's rally, which was driven by Nvidia's blowout earnings report, the tech sector was pulling back, which weighed on the tech-friendly Nasdaq.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 145 points, or 0.3%, to 53,715.
The S&P 500 gained 7 points, or 0.1%, to 7,738.
The Nasdaq composite fell 26 points, or 0.1%, to 26,515.
